nodes.label: Shell Grid (custom:au-shell-grid)
nodes.rationale: Full-dashboard layout container meant as the single top-level card of a Panel view; supports classic drag/resize grid or Apple Home → Rooms when floors is set.

nodes.label: AuCardContent
nodes.rationale: Enforces a grid-fill contract so the card host and .au-card surface always occupy 100% of space allocated by au-shell-grid via layout {w,h}.

nodes.label: AuActionCardBase
nodes.rationale: Provides entity binding, optional display fields, and HA-native tap/hold/double_tap_action handling with defaults toggle / more-info / more-info.

nodes.label: Grid-fill contract
nodes.rationale: Cards must fill 100% of shell-grid cell space so they resize when cells are dragged or resized in edit mode.

nodes.label: Home → Rooms floors pattern
nodes.rationale: Single au-shell-grid card with floors grouping rooms; tapping a room opens its entity grid; shared coordinate grid for Home overview and in-room tiles.

nodes.label: Shell Grid layout editing
nodes.rationale: Dashboard pencil enters edit mode with drag/resize/remove on desktop; Done persists layout to storage-mode dashboard YAML; stable id ties positions to cards.

nodes.label: HA CSS custom property design system
nodes.rationale: Structural styling maps to Home Assistant CSS Custom Properties so UI binds into custom themes, night-mode, and mobile; no raw hex, fixed pixels, or static weights hardcoded in components.

nodes.label: Card tag migration v0.1.0
nodes.rationale: Breaking rename: au-action-tile→au-action-card, au-sensor-readout→au-sensor-card; tap_service removed in favor of tap_action; au-home-dashboard removed in favor of floors on au-shell-grid.

nodes.label: Room tile light/switch controls strip
nodes.rationale: Room tiles sized w≥4 and h≥2 show a strip of light/switch icons (on first, capped at 6); tap icon toggles without opening room; configured via room_controls and per-room controls.
